title: Command & Conquer Generals PC Game 2003, EA - 2 Discs, VG
descriptionText:
This Command & Conquer: Generals PC game from EA Games is a must-have for any strategy game enthusiast. With its T-Teen rating, it offers online playability, and is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes. The game is part of the Command & Conquer Franchise video game series, and was released in 2003 as a two-disc set. 

The game is perfect for those who enjoy customizable gameplay, as it allows players to choose their preferred units and strategies. Additionally, it is a non-domestic product, and was manufactured in the United States. This game is a great addition to any PC gaming collection, and is sure to provide hours of entertaining gameplay.
